subject.title: feat: add Podman agent sandbox backend

question: After rebasing, is the reviewed Podman target-validation and shared container-engine boundary acceptable for built-in sandbox execution, including its Codex external-sandbox network mapping?
rationale: The product-location decision has a recorded recommendation, but accepting a new local container sandbox executor is a security-boundary judgment that cannot be settled by automated review alone.

options.title: Approve the bounded core adapter
options.body: Keep Podman alongside Docker and require fresh merge-candidate proof for Docker preservation, rootless Podman lifecycle, rejected unsupported connections, and Codex network-policy mapping.

options.title: Pause for a wider sandbox contract
options.body: Defer this PR if maintainers want Podman-specific configuration or lifecycle hooks to be designed as a general plugin/SDK capability first.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded core adapter
recommendation.body: Keep Podman alongside Docker and require fresh merge-candidate proof for Docker preservation, rootless Podman lifecycle, rejected unsupported connections, and Codex network-policy mapping.
